_note: CANDIDATE, not shipped. Merge this into the `hooks` object of your own settings.json by hand if you want it; ctx-kit never merges hooks automatically. It runs scripts/case-lint.py after a Write or Edit whose path lands in a case library, and prints the failing checks on stderr with exit 2 so they land in front of Claude. Silent and exit 0 for anything else, for an archive or the board, and for a clean case file. Not yet validated in day-to-day use: on a library with a backlog it will speak on almost every case edit until the backlog is worked off.

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/scripts/case-lint.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || s="$HOME/.claude/scripts/case-lint.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in ${CTXKIT_PYTHON:-} python3 /usr/local/bin/python3 /opt/homebrew/bin/python3; do if command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && "$c" -c 'import json' >/dev/null 2>&1; then p="$c"; break; fi; done; [ -n "${p:-}" ] || exit 0; f=$("$p" -c 'import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print((d.get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or "")' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in */CASES/*.md|*/cases/*.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; o=$("$p" "$s" --quiet "$f" 2>&1); rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 1 ] || exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$o" >&2; exit 2
